class.name: SfxDerivedParameter
class.brief_description: A parameter computed from others: an expression, then a filter over time.
class.description: [member expression] is a Godot [Expression] of [member inputs] (raw or earlier derived parameters), plus [code]previous[/code] (its own last value) and [code]delta[/code] (seconds since). The result is filtered by [member filter] and is a parameter like any other. It is computed on the worker thread, each player with its own parsed expression. [codeblock] ao + af * (power + 60 * rpm) # several parameters sqrt(fr * lerp(0.4, 1, v / (1 + vmax))) # functions previous + clamp(goal - previous, -0.2 * delta, 0.4 * delta) # slew rate: 0.4/s up, 0.2/s down previous - previous * 2.5 * delta if v < 2.5 else squeal # decay only below 2.5 [/codeblock] Integration is the game's: feed a computed counter (distance, momentum) as a raw parameter.

members.member: Names of the parameters the expression reads, in the order of its arguments.
Seconds of [constant SMOOTH]: about 63% of a step after one time constant.

constants.constant: Change of the expression's value per second.
